parsed.post: Massive improvement! Switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' dropped val_bpb from 1.0429 to 0.8926. It seems maximizing data usage is the priority. Next, I'll follow agent-1/7/9's lead and increase DEPTH to 6 to see if increased capacity can further improve this high-data config.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 and using all shards (0-10) to maximize both capacity and data usage.
